name: Twin Cities Concierge Simulated Session Experiment
description: Evaluation set designed to simulate a complete multi-turn session with the user, testing contextual memory and sequential database queries.

parts.text: Hi! I'm planning a day out in Minneapolis this Thursday, August 13th, 2026. Can you recommend a nice local coffee shop to start my morning?
That sounds great! After coffee, I'd love to see some live music later that night. Are there any events scheduled at local bars or jazz clubs on Thursday?
Awesome. What are the operating hours for that music venue, and does it fit my evening schedule?
I'm planning a Friday date night in St. Paul on August 14th, 2026. What's a cozy coffee shop we can stop by first?
Perfect. We want to catch some live jazz or acoustic music afterwards. Are there any events in St. Paul that evening?
That sounds lovely! What time does the event start, and what is the vibe of that venue?
